_about: William Ernest Johnson (1858-1931), Cambridge logician, Sidgwick Lecturer in Moral Science, teacher of Keynes and Ramsey. Raw IA OCR: Logic, Part I (Cambridge, 1921). Wanted: Logic Part II (1922) and Part III (1924). His surname is common, so only the initialled form is used. US public domain. No uids minted.
